findings.title: Live security contract was not verified
findings.why_it_matters: A post-apply mutation or incomplete reconciliation could leave the live Deployment without the security and resource settings that the role claims to prove.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert the live resources, securityContext, and APIService service target alongside the existing network and image checks.
evidence: Initial review snapshot: the live assertion checked image, args, placement, ports, and TLS mode but omitted resources and container securityContext fields already present in the desired contract.

residual_risks: The live freshness gate validates a current complete API response and sample metadata, but does not independently compare sample timestamps with controller wall-clock time.
